intro: Isi pax dan tarikh berlepas / balik — panjang trip, peak season dan semua surcharge dikira sendiri dan terus masuk dalam harga per pax. Peak season: 3★ +RM50/pax/malam dikira automatik; untuk malam peak yang guna hotel 4★, pilih Naik taraf Hotel 4★ – malam peak season pada baris hari itu (RM80 upgrade + RM10 beza peak). Kadar hari / malam tambahan belum diterbitkan — kalkulator akan tanda cip merah kadar? dan bukan RM 0; sahkan dengan PO sebelum quote hari tambahan.

validity: Prices follow the PT Padang - Bukittinggi 4D3N 2026 catalogue v7 (last updated 9 August 2026) and are valid for travel until 31 January 2027. This quotation is valid for 24 hours after submission. A deposit of RM250 per pax is due on confirmation and full payment 45 days before departure. Prices are based on 2 to 3 persons sharing a room; the 3-Star hotel offers double-sharing rooms as standard and a triple request is served with an extra bed. Final itinerary and hotel arrangements are confirmed 14 days before the trip. Private driver and guide are on a 12-hour basis; 150,000 IDR per extra hour is payable in cash to the driver. Itinerary, price and flight schedule are subject to change.
